page.overview:
Who is Carh'la Bastra?

Carh'la Bastra was a female Twi'lek who served as a Captain in Rebel Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.

After the Battle of Yavin, Captain Carh'la Bastra was stationed in Anchorhead, on the planet Tatooine, where she recruited new members to join the Rebellion's cause. During that time, she worked closely with Droma Ordo, another Rebel Alliance member in Anchorhead. The company smuggled most of its goods to the Rebellion.

In 1 ABY, Bastra was tasked with finding a cargo arrived recently from Tansarii Point Station. The cargo was now lost among the various denizens on Tatooine and both Rebel and Imperial Intelligence were very interested in finding it. Fortunately, a spacer agreed to help Bastra, instead of Imperial Commander Barrezz.

Captain Bastra first tasked the spacer with finding the inventory of the cargo content that was acquired by a group of Jawa traders. The Jawas had recently been spotted at Tosche Station, near Anchorhead. There, the spacer learned from the manager Cuan Talon that he should ask his warehouse manager Janus but the latter had already been killed by Desert Demons. From Janus' datapad, the spacer recovered the first part of the cargo data and discovered that the Jawa had also visited the Lars homestead. At the homestead, Zef Ando agreed to give the inventory of what he bought from the Jawas. The spacer finally reached the Jawa sandcrawler in the Western Dune Sea but it was under attack from Tusken Raiders. The spacer attacked the Tusken Raiders and rescued the Jawas and the droid FA-2PO. The spacer later recovered Jawa encryption keys from the Tusken Raiders and finally accessed to the sandcrawler database.
